title: Show what Linus sees for an unregistered maintainer's tag
description: Cover note says only that an unregistered maintainer's tag fails git verify-tag after flag day. Reproduce with real git and ssh-keygen in a throwaway registry: export with --min-tier maintainer, a tag signed by an unregistered key and by a below-tier key, git pull / git verify-tag / git log --show-signature; capture the exact messages. Document them (DESIGN or guide-anchors, and one line in the cover note) and say what the sender must do. If the message is unhelpful, consider whether git vouch can explain it (e.g. git vouch why <tag>) as a separate proposal, not built here.
acceptance_criteria: Exact outputs captured from real tools and documented; cover note line updated; any tooling idea filed as its own bead, not implemented.
close_reason: Measured verify-tag/pull/log output for unregistered and below-tier tags; documented in docs/guide-anchors.md Switch Linus's git and for-kernel-reviewers What it costs
